responsibility: Generated LoongArch backend header that maps hardware CPUCFG feature bits to GCC’s internal ISA-evolution option masks. Produced from isa-evolution.in, it defines the compact cpucfg_map table giving the CPUCFG word/bit location for each evolvable ISA feature, the cpucfg_useful_idx list of configuration words worth caching or probing, and the total CPUCFG word count; loongarch-cpu.cc and related native-target option logic use these tables when decoding cpucfg results for -march=native/-mtune=native and feature detection.
